title: Ragnarok VanFan Remastered
description: This is a 1.21.11 Hyper optimized, a lot of QoL, vanilla, and many previous vanfan mod pack content
body:
# Ragnarok VanFan Remastered

Ragnarok VanFan Remastered is a carefully curated Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric modpack focused on delivering the ultimate Vanilla+ experience.

Built around performance, quality-of-life improvements, exploration, building, farming, storage, and visual enhancements, VanFan Remastered preserves Minecraft's core gameplay while removing common frustrations and modernizing the experience.

### Key Features

• Hyper-optimized performance stack featuring Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, C2ME, Noisium, ImmediatelyFast, and many additional optimizations.

• Massive collection of Quality-of-Life improvements including inventory management, enhanced HUDs, better tooltips, dynamic crosshairs, improved storage systems, minimaps, waystones, graves, and better farming tools.

• Expanded exploration with Tectonic world generation, Nature's Compass, Explorer's Compass, Waystones, Fishing Frontier, Friends & Foes, and additional wildlife content.

• Enhanced building experience through Macaw's furniture and decorative mods, reinforced storage options, copper utilities, elevators, bridges, roofs, and expanded construction possibilities.

• Improved farming and cooking through Farmer's Delight and multiple compatibility add-ons, providing a deeper but still vanilla-friendly progression.

• Beautiful visual upgrades including Iris shader support, Fresh Animations compatibility, dynamic lighting, improved clouds, better biome blending, falling leaves, and enhanced entity models.

### Philosophy

VanFan Remastered follows a simple design philosophy:

Vanilla First. Features Second.

Every mod has been selected to enhance Minecraft without changing its identity. The result is a polished, modern Vanilla+ experience that feels like a natural evolution of the base game rather than a complete overhaul.
